Anna (Product): Heads up — we need to lock launch criteria for the 'Adaptive Prefetch v2' pilot. Product wants deterministic fallback, clear staging sequencing, and a concise acceptance checklist. @Raj @Mei @Diego :eyes:
Raj (Eng Runtime): Quick sketch: runtime needs KV-prefetch + prewarm orchestration and a routing policy that falls back to a smaller, quantized model on latency degradation. Prefetch is per-tenant TTL'd keys.
Mei (Eng Infra): Capacity question: what QPS & burst are we planning for? prewarm windows? we need numbers to reserve slots.
Anna (Product): Initial estimate: pilot steady ~500 QPS, weekday morning bursts up to ~2k QPS. Prewarm target window 60s. I'll run a quick traffic sim.
Raj (Eng Runtime): Sequencing proposal: 1) runtime: KV prefetch impl + fallback routing, 2) infra: prewarm hooks + reserved slots, 3) security: cache encryption/HSM gating. Runtime+infra must be merged before traffic switch. Canary plan needed.
Diego (Security): Security notes: HSM signing/keys will add ~20ms per request if on the critical path. We must not persist raw prompts in persistent cache without consent. Audit logs required for cached key access.
Claire (SRE): Ops checklist: circuit-breaker thresholds + clear fallback path. Suggest: if p95 latency >200ms for 2m -> route to fallback model; if p99 > 300ms escalate. Also need a fail-open test for cache misses.
Anna (Product): Draft acceptance criteria below — please poke holes.
```
AC:
- p99 latency <= 250ms for >=95% of tenants under pilot traffic
- fallback route to quantized-small-model exercised and validated with synthetic traffic
- prewarm success rate >= 90% within 60s of scaling action
- no raw user prompts written to persistent cache; cache encrypted at rest + access logged
- HSM gating latency characterized and SLA impact documented
```
Raj (Eng Runtime): Dev tasks I see: 1) KV prefetch implementation + metrics, 2) routing policy + canary flags, 3) integration test harness for synthetic fallback. Potential perf risk: kernel path for bulk KV fill at scale.
Mei (Eng Infra): Infra tasks: 1) reserve 4 prewarm GPU slots per region for pilot, 2) autoscale policy tuned for 2k burst, 3) deploy loadgen to simulate multi-tenant bursts for validation.
Diego (Security): Security tasks: 1) review cache encryption design, 2) validate HSM latency and CI gate, 3) update compliance checklist for cached artifacts.
Anna (Product): Timeline suggestion: alpha in 3 sprints (assuming no major blockers). I'll consolidate into a PRD and tag owners. :thumbsup:
Raj (Eng Runtime): Real blocker: kernel-level perf tweaks for concurrent KV prefill — could slip runtime by ~1 sprint unless we get early perf cycles.
Mei (Eng Infra): Blocker: need org approval for dedicated GPU capacity for prewarm. Eng capacity planning loop is in flight; pinging finance.
Claire (SRE): I'll produce a runbook/incident playbook for canary and fallback routing, include escalation steps and postmortem template.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-test-env -> 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z
Anna (Product): Thanks — will post PRD link + traffic sim results here once ready. Any other immediate blockers?
Raj (Eng Runtime): I'll attach a short perf checklist in the PRD.
Diego (Security): I'll start the HSM impact doc and flag any hard blockers early.
Mei (Eng Infra): Will confirm GPU slot reservation ETA by EOD tomorrow.
Anna (Product): Great, keeping this thread as the canonical pre-launch sync. :raised_hands:
